WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

upsert_client AS (
    INSERT INTO clients (
        client_code,
        name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website,
        status
    )

    SELECT
        data->>'client_code',
        data->>'client_name',
        data->>'company_name',
        data->>'client_email',
        NULLIF(data->>'website', ''),
        'active'

    FROM input_data

    ON CONFLICT (client_code)

    DO UPDATE SET
        name = EXCLUDED.name,
        company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name,
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        website = EXCLUDED.website,
        status = 'active'

    RETURNING
        id,
        client_code,
        name,
        company_name,
        email,
        website,
        status,
        created_at,
        updated_at
),

save_campaign AS (
    INSERT INTO campaigns (
        campaign_code,
        client_id,
        source_submission_id,
        product_service,
        target_audience,
        offer,
        objective,
        brand_tone,
        status,
        brief
    )

    SELECT
        input_data.data->>'campaign_code',

        upsert_client.id,

        CONCAT(
          'WEB-',
          input_data.data->>'submission_id'
        ),

        input_data.data->>'product_service',

        input_data.data->>'target_audience',

        input_data.data->>'offer',

        input_data.data->>'campaign_objective',

        input_data.data->>'brand_tone',

        'brief_received',

        input_data.data->'brief'

    FROM input_data

    CROSS JOIN upsert_client

    ON CONFLICT (source_submission_id)

    DO UPDATE SET
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_code,
        client_id,
        source_submission_id,
        product_service,
        target_audience,
        offer,
        objective,
        brand_tone,
        status,
        brief,
        portal_token,
        portal_token_expires_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '02W - Website Campaign Intake API',

        save_campaign.id,

        'info',

        'campaign_intake_saved',

        'Website client and campaign brief saved successfully.',

        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'submission_id',
                input_data.data->>'submission_id',

            'source_submission_id',
                save_campaign.source_submission_id,

            'campaign_code',
                save_campaign.campaign_code,

            'client_code',
                upsert_client.client_code,

            'company_name',
                upsert_client.company_name,

            'source',
                'adflow_website'
        )

    FROM save_campaign

    CROSS JOIN upsert_client

    CROSS JOIN input_data

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1

        FROM automation_logs existing_log

        WHERE existing_log.campaign_id =
            save_campaign.id

          AND existing_log.workflow_name =
            '02W - Website Campaign Intake API'

          AND existing_log.event_type =
            'campaign_intake_saved'
    )

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,

    save_campaign.id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    save_campaign.campaign_code,

    save_campaign.source_submission_id,

    save_campaign.status,

    save_campaign.portal_token,

    save_campaign.portal_token_expires_at,

    save_campaign.created_at,

    save_campaign.updated_at,

    upsert_client.id::TEXT
        AS client_id,

    upsert_client.client_code,

    upsert_client.name
        AS client_name,

    upsert_client.company_name,

    upsert_client.email
        AS client_email,

    upsert_client.website,

    'Campaign brief received successfully.'
        AS message

FROM save_campaign

JOIN upsert_client
    ON upsert_client.id =
       save_campaign.client_id;
